notes.title: 13.0.8 bugfix
notes.notes:
We're continuing to fix bugs in multiplayer game, loading, and saving.

**Known Issues (Still Not Fixed):**

- If the host loads a previously saved online game, it's best to restart the app before loading again or starting a new game.

- Only one online player per Steam account, Apple ID, or Google Play account. If you're using multiple devices (like a tablet and a smartphone with the same account, or two laptops on the same Steam account), the second device may not be recognized correctly.

notes.title: 13.0.6 bugfix
notes.notes:
Thank you to all players who spent time tracking and reporting the issues, with detailed descriptions of their actions. It really helps!

Fixed:
- FINALLY Windows/Android cloud saves issue. We finally tracked what was causing non-syncing.
- One hidden game mechanic wasn't working as intended. We fixed it and several achievements were fixed as a result.
- Multiplayer save/load. Also we added multiplayer autosaves, and multiple online saves storage (instead of one).

Remember, to load the multiplayer save:
1) All users have to be authorized before joining the initial game
2) Only the host can save the game
3) To load the game, the same users have to exit the current game (if it's on) and rejoin the same host in the lobby. Wait for the host to click "load game", then set as "ready" and start the game.

There's still an issue if connected players click "ready" before the host, it'll be fixed later.

To find fellow Timeflow multiplayer buddies, please join https://discord.gg/yWWJZD6zTT

notes.title: Update 12.1
notes.notes:
Added:

- Rotational Work.
Good pay. 6 -month contract. No education required. Requires almost all free time and drastically increases stress. No career growth.

- Holidays.
Only if the character is enrolled to a higher education. On the summer and winter purple squares,  "break" card appears, removing the time spent on education for 3 months and 1 month, respectively. Since it's not hardcoded, there are some nuances:
- If the "holiday" square is skipped, there will be no breaks.
- Education may end during the break, but the time saved will remain.
- The same applies if the player decides to drop out.

- Abbreviations for thousands and millions to k and m.
Now, numbers like 100,000 are displayed as 100k, and 1,200,000 as 1.2m. This can be enabled via a checkbox in the currency settings, either at the start of the game or through the menu > Currency.

- Game difficulty now affects salaries and businesses.
Easy level: Salary +10%, Business +15%
Medium level: No changes
Hard level: Salary -10%, Business -15%
Special level: Salary -20%, Business -30%
Hardcore: Salary -30%, Business -50%

- Limited the number of crypto-related events to 1-2 per year.

Interface Improvements:
If you click on the "Hourly Pay" and "Stress" lines in the balance, a window will open listing all related cards. Sorting has been added to this window, making it easy to calculate which activities are efficient and which are not.

On the final chart, different life events are marked with vertical lines. Different colors have been added to event groups to make them easier to distinguish.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed the rapid growth of dividend stocks when playing with multiple characters.
Various other bugs.

Upcoming Plans:
- End game scoring system
- Multiplayer game testing

notes.title: Big update released!
notes.notes:
We're excited to release the new update. Here's a short breakdown of what's new.

Exact Moves.
Now you can move to the desired square at will. Exact moves are immediately available on the easy level. On the medium level, you need to study Planning, and on the hard level and above – Motivation.

Personal Residence.
The concept of owning housing for rent and purchase has been added, in 3 options (modest, common, hi-end). The size of the housing affects stress depending of the size of the family.

Dreams.
Unique bonuses have been added for buying each dream at each difficulty level. Landing on the dream square increases mood regardless of purchase.

Cryptocurrency.
The concept of risk levels for crypto exchanges has been added. Now, when trading, there is a risk of losing a single transaction or the entire crypto wallet. Risk levels can be reduced through experience, training, and networking. Risks may change during the game and in crisis. You can see what affects the current risk level. in the stock interface. Events have been added that nullify the crypto for all players and temporarily increase risks in crypto.

Stock Market.
Events related to the stock market are applied instantly. Short sales are not possible when a crisis starts.

Stress.
The maximum mood now depends on the stress level. Stress-related and motivational workshops. Vacationing reduces stress for several months.

Content.
New expenses and routines have been added. Added options to add time on expense of personal and family time. A personal accountant, crypto consultant, and business mentor have been added. Sports partially compensate age time penalty. The birth of a child makes the character lose several TM skills. Car accidents with different insurance options have been added.

Balance.
Small business income bonuses in quests have been doubled. The cash penalty for lack of time is now displayed in the balance. The penalty increases by 50% for each level of difficulty starting from medium. 3 jobs max. If you write a successful book, royalties increase immediately.

Interface.
Up to 8 players. Increased both limits of currency setting values. Detailed card bonuses and penalties breakdown. Buttons for bank payment or loan issuance have been added to the bankruptcy window. Repeated offers on the news square are limited: when refusing one, all similar cards are not offered until the next character's birthday (sports, insurance, assistants, car, loans, borrowing, pyramid scheme, charity). A counter on the exchange and market buttons shows the number of open positions and active deals.

End of the Game.
Final game graphs redesigned.

===

Next to come:

- Fix errors found by players after the release
- Finish eng-game point system
- Test the multiplayer we already made

Support the developers by leaving a review, buying optionable in-app items (skins and city maps), or buying a mobile version (iOS and Android).

notes.title: August Update
notes.notes:
Development news.

Over the past month, we have been rebuilding the project. Rebuilding, or refactoring, has long been needed. Since the first release back in 2015, we've been adding more and more functions, that were not originally planned. Let's take at least the size of the database - in the very first version there were about 200 events with simple conditions, and now there are several thousand of them with complex, cross-trigger conditions. All this impacted stability and performance, plus it was bad for a true multiplayer online game. Wo what's the plan now?

1. Test the rebuild on iOS/Android. Technically, the game has changed a lot from the inside, but it should be more stable than previous versions. Hopefully, the test won't take long.

2. Add a series of features that did not make it to the 11th version: endgame scoreboard, more players, stock companies, and chitcoin bankruptcy (hey you cryptopunks!)

3. Content not included in the 11th version. Quests for real estate - affect the gameplay. New expenses - do not affect the game, but make the game a bit funnier for those who have memorized all the texts already.

4. The unjustified war crippled our income so unfortunately, we don't have the resources to hire professional translators, as was planned for 2022. So I guess we'll go with a crowdsourced translation solution somewhere here. The game has tons of texts, I guess it'll take a while.

5. Transfer the entire database from the game to the server to make updates easier.

6. Finally start making true online multiplayer (yaaay!). Given 1 and 4, it will be much easier.

7. Content editor. Most likely it will not be done beautifully with a GUI, but as a database that can be edited manually. Still an option to make your own content, right?

notes.title: What'll be new in Timeflow v11?
notes.notes:
The 11th version has been published some time ago on Android and iOS. With the help of our players, we polished it and fixed it, and it'll be released to Steam in a few days. Here you can see what to expect from the new version.

[previewyoutube=M2p41OE7FR4;full][/previewyoutube]

1. Multiple choice
- You can choose from different assets
- Choose whom to hire, insurance, sports, car, etc.
- TM-skill "Information" increases the number of options to choose from.

2. Work and career
- You can look for a job yourself on the green cell "Opportunity" (auto job search is disabled)
- Added part-time job (without career growth)
- Career now has 6 tiers instead of 4
- Work experience required for promotion
- Increased the minimum period between work events after obtaining a new position
- New acquaintance for promotion - a fellow HR manager
- All promotion requirements are no longer universal but are tied to career paths
- Advanced training increases salary in only one career path

3. Economic Sectors
- All assets, shares, and work are now tied to different Economic Sectors
- Sectors can rise and fall (1 change per year)
- Different sectors have different up and down ranges
- Growth and fall of sectors are reflected differently in different types of assets
- Different sectors behave differently in a crisis

4. New business events
- Each business has 2 new "quests."
- For each quest, there are 2-3 solutions
- Each solution has 2 random consequences
- Total 88 situations, 216 solutions, 429 consequences
- You can give each business a unique name
- Now business and real estate can go below zero and cause permanent losses instead of profits

5. Difficulty levels, victory conditions, game length
- With increasing age, the character receives fewer events per year (the length of the movement increases).
- Each difficulty level now has its own requirements for victory
- The easier the level, the easier the requirements, and the easier it is to win
- The "Savings" requirement to win now subtracts the player's loans
- After winning, you can increase the difficulty level and continue the game
- You can continue the game the same way in retirement (but you won't be able to win)
- Each dream has three levels of achievement for three levels of difficulty
- An already purchased dream can pop up again and increase the character's mood
- Reduced player's spendings (routines) for easy and medium difficulty

6. Stock market interface
- Two new stocks ("Beta, Inc", and "Wholefoots")
- You can choose 1 of 3 shopping options
- If you complete the training, a professional stock market interface becomes available
- Margin requirements are changing to increase the max possible trading loan (leverage)
- The change in the price of purchased shares is visible above the balance sheet without entering the exchange

7. Assets sale
- You can resell purchased assets between players, in the same way as non-purchased opportunities


8. Interface
- All notifications of the same type are combined into one
- All balance points can be clicked for hints
- Increased font size for smartphones
- Increased the size of the avatar on the field
- Increased the size of pictures in cards
- The map on the left has been moved so that the avatar always fits on the field
- Fixed camera behavior
- Game hints on/off mode

9. Cloud saves
- You can store saves in the cloud
- Authorization via Google
- You can start on your smartphone and continue on your computer and vice versa

10. New graphics
- Idle animation of all avatars
- New map, available to everyone by default
- The old map is available as an in-app purchase
- New balance skins available as an in-app purchase

11. Donations
- You can become a subscriber or give a one-time donation to support the development
- Donations do not affect the game, but they can be displayed in the interface (optional)

notes.title: 1.10 release + 1.11 announcement
notes.notes:
Good news everyone – we passed a 2000 positive reviews mark for Android, and 1000 for AppStore. AppStore reviews are divided by countries so unfortunately, it’s way less for each user but still an important milestone for us as developers.

As a reminder, if you like the game you can leave a review and get a free mobile copy. And if you really like it and willing to support us, you can leave a review and buy a mobile copy. After all, not so many developers give a mobile game for free in addition to a PC one. So for us, this option is a way to promote the game, and your reviews help us A LOT.

Join our facebook group: [url=https://www.facebook.com/timeflowproject]https://www.facebook.com/timeflowproject[/url]
Or maybe we should use some other place for communication with gamers, please advise!

[h1]What’s new in 1.10:[/h1]

+ Localization improved. We spent some time with a native English speaker to make the localization less broken haha.
+ Easy and medium levels now can refuse marriage and kids. With consequences, of course.
+ Job, Business, and Real Estate now increase stress. It'll be less fun to run 10 different assets at once.
+ The entire stress system is revised.
+ Now you can see what affects stress and other characteristics
+ Log window is draggable now (drag by the log top).
+ Easy deposit buttons. 50%, 100%, 0%, and so on.
+ Each game can now have its own currency
* Numerous Bugfixes

Some new features don’t fully work with old savegames. You can still load an old savegame, but there’s a chance a stress and mood system will stick to default numbers.

[h1]What’s planned in 1.11?[/h1]

+ For international release: a choice between 3 ethnic groups of avatars. Current avatars will be in a Caucasian/White group. Two new avatar groups – Asian and Latino/Black.

+ Advanced stock market. Buy and sell when you want. Right now it is being tested and we have a feeling that it slows down the pace when you can think on new stock actions every single turn. We definitely don’t want to make Timeflow a stock market simulator. We’re planning to keep the current simplified interface as is with an option to go advanced if your character took a specific stock market education.

+ Draw 2, keep 1 card feature. Very convenient for assets, work, gadgets, personnel, cars, insurances, sports. It should speed up the game process a little since there’ll be less time wasted on a specific card search.

+ To use this new feature, your character has to obtain a time management skill “Information”. We’ll make it available earlier in the game to make it more usable in the beginning (compared to as it now).

+ Hope to move job search to green Opportunity cell and place it next to Business, Real Estate, and Stocks.

BTW, if you haven't heard, you can still get a free mobile version if you publish a positive review on Steam and send us the proof at [url=mailto:support@timeflow.ru]support@timeflow.ru[/url]

On screenshots (these are just some of the tweaks, obvi):

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1284500][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34341572/f910fa3953411e664afd1b080c938a574bbd801f.jpg[/img][/url]

Soundtrack. You've been asking since forever, and here it is – from mp3 to lossless. If you want to support us, you can buy it (we'll be real happy). 80 minutes. For now, it's only available on the new Steam Soundtracks native player (but we may upload it somewhere else, too): [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1284500]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1284500[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34341572/a95e43308b41c24942aa66f34de72ea5c91eaca1.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34341572/2db06ccb4d62f82749c0e83d52e4e2a451aba8c0.png[/img]

Dividends. How it works: Every company may or may not pay out dividends once a year. How much you get depends on how volatile the current company is. In the case of a short position, it is the player who pays the dividends. After the payment of dividends comes the ex-dividend date: a stock's price falls down and slowly rises back up. We also added a highly volatile cryptocurrency and dropped silver. You still can't buy any stocks at any time though (it'll come later).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34341572/fd42e4499bfccc627a040a5f4bd66f607b6af321.png[/img]

Custom currency. You can fine-tune the numbers (raise or lower) and pick any currency symbol you like. This will NOT change the game balance, so this feature is purely visual. Maybe somebody wants to see his wage as $20/hour, not 100T as it right now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34341572/03d16329dacac1fc1f7d2de0e1e1039fecb4a8bb.jpg[/img]

New map(s). Still under construction. You can see the concept art on the screenshot. We have it in 3D, but can't show it just yet. We want to add multiple maps from various areas to make things interesting, but the cost of 3D art is ridiculously high for an indie game. We now get why pixel art and low poly are in. So, for now, we're trying to strike a balance between cost, speed, and quality.

Every feature is a ton of game design, interface, coding, and UI tweaks. It goes something like this: come up with an idea, draw it, explain it, code it, test it, revise it, repeat x10, and only then turn it in and move on.

notes.title: Progress Report November'19
notes.notes:
Here you can see the upcoming character editor windows. The mechanics are based on the idea of "points", which can be used to buy different things for your character. If you lack on points, you can get more by making your character older, or taking more responsibility by having a family, or just get some bad habits. There are currently two limitations: you can't start the game with a negative amount of points, or not having enough time.

In the progress of making the editor, we had to drop off the idea of changing the character's avatars as they age. The test results were not cool, time-consuming and expensive. Perhaps if the avatars were modular, generating in the game engine, it could be done, but for now we'll postpone this idea to the next project :D

notes.title: Progress Report Fall'19
notes.notes:
What are we doing now and why aren't there any updates?

We've decided to change the way we release updates. Instead of many small patches, there's going to be a few major updates with multiple new features. So, here's what to expect:

1. Multiplayer
Through trial and error, we've finally found an appropriate solution for an online multiplayer.
The server's almost done, now we're working on the game client. Online gaming is a whole other world where you have to foresee millions of different scenarios while trying to eliminate cheaters.
Shoutout to game developers, these guys work HARD.

2. Character Creator
You will be able to customize your character. Each player will be granted a certain number of Starting Points they can spend on education, career level, starting capital, or many other useful things.
If you don't have enough points, you can get more by willing to accept some responsibilities: having family and kids, helping out your parents. Bad habits and being older at the start will also rack up some points. We don't want to restrict you too much: if you want to create a character with a great career, loads of money, and all kinds of connections -- then so be it, but the difficulty will be considered as "Easy".

3. Aging
One of the key changes. You have to win before you retire, and the older your character is, the less time you have. Besides, as your character grows older, you will have less free time at your disposal. The avatar won't be changing though, the current avatar style isn't so affordable and flexible for such a feature.

4. The age of family members (and more)
At some point, children grow older and start to live on their own, so we're allowing you to cancel out your lack of free time as you age with reduced spendings on your children. Maybe they'll even start to help you out. This might work in some other cases, too, -- although, say, if you're a dog lover and your doggo goes to doggo heaven, you'll probably going to get another one at some point.

5. Tutorial and tips
An interactive tutorial is a great way to attract new players. This idea sounds so simple, but somehow it's hard to implement and has eaten up a lot of our resources already (but we're not giving up just yet!).

6. Really working stock market
So that you can buy or sell any stocks you want, and not just the ones you got randomly. Plus a portfolio to collect a large number of assets. We're not going to add options, bonds, or dividends yet, but will add cryptocurrency. The interface is done, next is the code.

7. Unforeseen expenses
Many of you have expressed how ill-conceived it is to buy a cow you can't afford, figuratively speaking. Well, it's "a cow or major depression" type of situation. If your character is consistently sad, he or she may get depressed and will have to seek professional help. So it's either crying or paying, whichever one you like. Right now it's just a general idea, which we will test out and make sure that it doesn't lead to a generation of depressed millionaires who live on ramen noodles for 15 years to make it and get help later. Real life doesn't work like that, you're gonna end up either crazy or dead.

8. Achievements
These are just for fun. Some will be visible, some hidden, depending on which ones will be easier to employ without spending too much. We're also working on achievements for Steam, Play Store, and App Store.

9. Final cutscenes
To be honest, the Dream Fulfilled cutscenes have been ready for almost a year. We just haven't gotten around to actually adding them to the game. Also, we're not really sure, do we have to show them right after the purchase or in the end? If right away then you can see them without actually winning the game. Not cool. If in the end, that's just weird: you landed on the Moon at thirty, but saw it at sixty-five? Or made enough money for the space travel by thirty and waited for another thirty-five years to go? Weird. Surprisingly complicated game design issue. 

10. Business quests
We also really want to make business and real estate much more unpredictable than they are now. We've already scripted and added the chance cards, which present two new events, 2 to 3 choices, and two potential outcomes (so, 500! unique events overall).
The main difference between already existing events is that there are different potential outcomes. We also want to add variable return on business, from losses to breaking even to profit. But to do that properly, we would have to rethink the whole system, which we obviously don't want to do. So, another game design issue.

11. Major changes
There's the problem: the more features the game has, the sooner it starts to crumble under its own weight. This is why, after a certain amount of time, TF starts to lag on Android, and we have little idea how to fix it. 
We need to change the whole game engine, really. Although we want to do everything properly, we still can't change all at once. There are some ideas concerning TF 2.0. where we will use all our experience and all your suggestions. We'll think more about it as soon as we solve issues 1 to 10 :)

All the best,
Roman

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: Timeflow
notes.notes:
Premature Evaluation is the weekly column in which Steve Hogarty explores the wilds of early access. This week it’s an educational time management and capitalism sim called Timeflow.

Developer: Roman Makhmutov
Publisher: Roman Makhmutov

Release: Out now (early access)
On: Windows, MacOSX
From: Steam
For: 4.79, $6, 5

Hello again, it s me, the premature evaluator. When I m not prematurely evaluating things, you will often find me sabotaging my own life through chronic mismanagement of my bank balance and available free time. For example, I am writing this article in the very last moments before it s due to be published, not because I have an especially pressing schedule I ve spent the last five hours preparing to write by eating cold leftover curry, having a big nap on the sofa and watching old episodes of Pointless on iPlayer but simply because my brain refuses to operate without a hard deadline looming on my mental horizon, like a bad Godzilla.

(more…)
